title: 劳力士年产115万只：热门款却要等数年，到底卡在哪一步？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: A Rolex is the world's most recognizable luxury watch, but actually getting your hands on one can be surprisingly difficult.
segments.zh: 劳力士是全球辨识度最高的奢华腕表，但想真正拥有一块却出奇地难。

segments.en: I'm Chris Rouser with Bloomberg ProSuits, and I'm here to walk you through the complicated process of getting your first.
segments.zh: 我是彭博ProSuits的Chris Rouser，今天带你走一遍拿到第一块表的复杂流程。

segments.en: The problem is not a lack of watches. Rolex makes about 1.15 million of them every year, and 2,500 secondhand watches are sold online every day,
segments.zh: 问题不在于缺表。劳力士每年生产约115万块，每天线上还能卖出2500块二手表，

segments.en: but the process can be opaque and, of course, they're expensive.
segments.zh: 但过程可能不透明，而且当然，价格不菲。

segments.en: Rolex has started at about $6,500 and can go up into the tens of thousands.
segments.zh: 劳力士起价约6500美元，高的能到数万美元。

segments.en: Weightless for popular models that authorized dealers can run for months or even years.
segments.zh: 热门款往往要等，授权经销商可能让你等上几个月甚至几年。

segments.en: I'm here at Fagora, an awesome secondhand dealer in Great Neckland Island, to see what they have on hand.
segments.zh: 我现在在Fagora，长岛一家很棒的二手表商，看看他们手头有什么。

segments.en: Once you have a clear idea of what model you want, there are a couple ways to secure the watch.
segments.zh: 一旦你明确想要哪款，就有几种方式能拿到表。

segments.en: The first and best is to buy from an authorized dealer, a boutique that says Rolex on the door.
segments.zh: 第一种也是最好的，是从授权经销商买，就是门口写着劳力士的精品店。

segments.en: Spend time talking with the sales associate. Be flexible.
segments.zh: 花时间和销售顾问聊聊，保持灵活。

segments.en: A different color or metal may be easier to find. The relationship you develop with that person can help you get the watch sooner rather than later.
segments.zh: 换个颜色或金属材质可能更容易找到。和对方建立关系，能帮你更快拿到表。

segments.en: Tell them your story whether it's for an anniversary, a personal achievement, or as a gift for a loved one.
segments.zh: 告诉他们你的故事，无论是纪念日、个人成就，还是送给亲人的礼物。

segments.en: The dealer wants to know you're not just going to flip it for profit.
segments.zh: 经销商想知道你不是为了转手获利。

segments.en: Buying on the primary market is preferable because you'll get the best warranty and you'll start building a relationship with Rolex, which will help you get better access to more watches in the future.
segments.zh: 在一级市场购买更可取，因为你能获得最佳保修，并开始与劳力士建立关系，这有助于未来更容易获得更多表款。

segments.en: But because authorized dealers only get limited allocations every year, you may have to also look at a secondhand dealer if you want to get one faster.
segments.zh: 但由于授权经销商每年获得的配额有限，如果想更快拿到，你可能还得看看二手经销商。
